New Graduate and Professional Students
The University of Iowa has a long-standing history of setting an example in higher education. We were the first coeducational public university in the United States and we were the first to establish the Master of Fine Arts. Our law, health care, and fine arts programs are continuously ranked among the best in the nation.
Admission requirements vary by degree program. To find requirements, cost, and deadlines, navigate to your specific area of study below. Students may apply to only one program unless you are applying to a Combined Degree Program.
